question: The following may occur in multimeric form associated with the J chain:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Secretory component added -> IgA and IgM -> 95% CHAIN: Multimeric form associated with the J chain -> Secretory component added -> IgA and IgD -> 95%
enhanced_information: The multimeric form associated with the J chain is primarily linked to IgA and IgM. The presence of the secretory component further associates IgA with IgD. Therefore, the correct options are opa. IgA and IgG and opb. IgD and IgM.
analysis: The multimeric form associated with the J chain is primarily linked to IgA and IgM. The presence of the secretory component further associates IgA with IgD. Therefore, the correct options are IgA and IgG (opa) and IgD and IgM (opb).
